lobby_counter_reconciliation.question: Resolve the lobby's 'This week 68 matches this week' counter against the fixtures API (open follow-up from session 0f6c89c6's log).
observed_facts: Lobby page (read 2026-10-13T21:58:00Z): counter '68 matches this week'; week timer 'Resets in 5d 02h 01m 32s' (implies a week boundary near 2026-10-19 00:00 UTC); CS2 tab filter 'All tiers (90)'; tournament filter 'All tournaments (90)'; team filter 'All teams (90)'.

Fixtures API snapshot data/961/lobby.json (captured 2026-10-13T21:53:09Z): 292 non-ended rows in the collector window (scheduled_start >= now-24h): 33 CS2 + 259 LoL; statuses scheduled 273 / cancelled 16 / started 3.

Candidate counts recomputed from that snapshot: 139 rows scheduled inside Mon 2026-10-12 .. Sun 2026-10-19 UTC week (127 of them scheduled status); 32 CS2 in that week; 33 CS2 in window; 149 within 7 days; 276 not cancelled/ended. None equals 68 or 90.
lobby_counter_reconciliation.conclusion: UNRESOLVED — flagged, not guessed. The public fixtures API exposes no 'pick'em week' field and no documented filter reproduces the lobby's 68 (or the 90 shown by the CS2 filters). The 68 figure is therefore published only as a quoted lobby-counter observation with its source URL and read time; it is not used in any calculation.

pickem_label_decision.question: Decide whether the /pickem/ board's 'bc.game (via EGamersWorld)' label should be replaced by the unnamed-widget label used on verify961 (open follow-up from session 0f6c89c6's log).
pickem_label_decision.observation: The public CS2 matches list at egamersworld.com (read 2026-10-13T22:08:00Z) renders bare odds pairs next to a 'Make a bet' link with no bookmaker name in the page text; the 'bc.game' attribution was captured from the interactive odds widget by the pickem session.
pickem_label_decision.decision: Keep both labels in their own boards. They describe the same public odds widget with different (individually sourced) attribution detail. verify961 continues to say 'egamersworld.com odds widget' (host-attributed, reproducible from the page text); pickem keeps 'bc.game (via EGamersWorld)' with its widget capture as evidence.
